name: Crawfordville Christmas in the Park at Hudson Park
paras: The Wakulla County Sheriff's Office and Wakulla County Administration host Christmas in the Park, billed as the most wonderful night in Wakulla, on Friday, December 11, from 6 to 9 PM at Hudson Park, 21 Ochlocknee Street in Crawfordville.

The county lists the celebration as free for families, with complimentary hot dogs, popcorn and drinks. Santa hands out presents to children, and kids can use a bounce house while a Christmas movie plays under the stars.
Holiday vendors sell treats and crafts. The county asks guests to bring chairs and blankets for the movie and the evening of lights.
tip: Bring chairs or blankets for the outdoor Christmas movie.
